title: Sony BRAVIA XBR-55X850D — Android TV 8.0.0 / API 26, Sony firmware 6.827
header:
Sony BRAVIA XBR-55X850D — Android TV 8.0.0 / API 26, Sony firmware 6.827
Android's generic model label is "BRAVIA 4K 2015"; match the retail model/firmware too.
Tested with CleanYourTV v2.3, source 6bcd649bfd6fb4ed0e448c369a258b672a0a1a0b.
Roku Ultra LT supplies streaming; this is an owner's short-term tested list, not every Sony.

Apply: TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-xbr-55x850d/debloat.txt
Undo:  TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-xbr-55x850d/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED for user 0, not uninstalled. Save original enabled states first.
Install and verify the replacement Home before the final stock-launcher entry below.
Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher; replacement: com.gathin.tvhome.
Live TV AND HDMI playback app: com.sony.dtv.tvx — KEEP IT ENABLED.
Keep Sony TV/input providers, CEC/BRAVIA Sync, remote/pairing, keyboard, Settings,
Google services/Store, MediaTek services, firmware updater, recovery and boot monitor.
Chromecast, DLNA, mirroring, phone remote and Assistant were left enabled, not removed.
Developer options calls the switch "ADB debugging" on this firmware.
See README.md here for tested functions, launcher configuration and timing limits.
